query:
INSERT INTO user_entitlements (user_id, tier, valid_until, source, updated_at)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, now())
            ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
                SET tier = EXCLUDED.tier,
                    valid_until = EXCLUDED.valid_until,
                    source = EXCLUDED.source,
                    updated_at = now()
